PNL-QL-071.template: A trader purchases different lots of articles at the given unit costs and sells them at the stated unit prices. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-072.template: Two articles are sold for the same selling price. One is sold at a {firstRatePercent}% {firstDirection}, while the other is sold at a {secondRatePercent}% {secondDirection}. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-073.template: Two articles have the same cost price. One is sold at a {firstRatePercent}% {firstDirection}, while the other is sold at a {secondRatePercent}% {secondDirection}. Find the overall profit or loss percentage.

PNL-QL-074.template: A dealer buys {totalQuantity} identical articles at ₹{unitCostPrice} each. Different groups are sold at the stated prices, while the remaining stock is unsold or recovered at the stated value. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-075.template: A trader buys {totalQuantity} articles at ₹{unitCostPrice} each. Of these, {damagedQuantity} articles are damaged and recovered at ₹{damagedRecoveryPerUnit} each. At what price per article should the remaining stock be sold to obtain the required overall result?

PNL-QL-076.template: A wholesaler pays for {paidQuantity} articles and receives {freeQuantity} additional articles free. If every article is sold at ₹{unitSellingPrice}, calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.
